description: Any ros2_control robot: sensor_msgs/JointState in, a forward_position_controller (Float64MultiArray) out.
notes: joints {} means: match the model's joint names to JointState.name; set joints to rename.
command type may be std_msgs/msg/Float64MultiArray, sensor_msgs/msg/JointState or trajectory_msgs/msg/JointTrajectory.

A Float64MultiArray command has no names: its slots follow the controller's joints parameter, read at connect; set command.joints to give that order yourself. Connect refuses when neither is there or they are not exactly the model's joints.
